draft: Sunlight filters through azure skies in an idyllic Mexico City, casting dappled light on bustling streets filled with laughter. Banners of unity flutter gently amidst hydrologists' careful balance between conservation and use. Neighborhood co-ops loom tall, symbolizing mutual aid that underpins the community. Harmony and cooperation prevail as trust and collective well-being take precedence over individual gain in this alternative version free from authoritarianism, environmental collapse, social conflict, or capitalist hegemony.
